description: Searchable audio archive of Sheikh Al-Sha'rawy: type a phrase, land on the exact second it was said, words highlight as he speaks. Django+DRF+pgvector+Meilisearch backend, standalone ASR pipeline, Next.js RTL frontend, R2 storage.
environmentNotes: No real Sha'rawy audio or GPU here: ASR/alignment/embedding engines are pluggable with deterministic stub engines used for tests; real faster-whisper/e5 integrations ship in pipeline/ but are exercised only via stubs. Filename parser is config-driven regex (sample filenames unavailable).

userStories.title: Infrastructure foundation
acceptanceCriteria: Root CLAUDE.md and SHAARAWY_PROJECT_PLAN.md exist
docker-compose.yml: postgres uses pgvector/pgvector:pg16 image, adds meilisearch (getmeili/meilisearch) and minio services with healthchecks and exposed ports
Makefile has dev, be, fe, test, lint, types targets that run the documented commands
backend/requirements.txt includes pgvector, meilisearch, boto3, pytest, pytest-django, ruff, mypy, django-stubs
A local venv at .venv installs backend requirements and `python manage.py check` passes with DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=core.settings.dev
docker compose up brings db (pgvector), redis, meilisearch, minio to healthy state; `SELECT extversion FROM pg_extension` possible after CREATE EXTENSION vector succeeds

userStories.title: Arabic normalization module
acceptanceCriteria: backend/corpus/arabic.py exposes normalize_for_index(s) (all 8 spec steps) and normalize_light(s) (steps 1-3 only), both typed

Steps exactly per spec: NFC; strip tatweel U+0640; strip harakat U+064B-U+0652, U+0670, U+06D6-U+06ED; hamza variants to bare alif; ta marbuta->ha, alif maqsura->ya, waw/ya hamza fold (index only); whitespace collapse; Arabic-Indic digits (both U+0660 and U+06F0 ranges) to ASCII
backend/corpus/tests/fixtures/normalization_pairs.json holds >=50 tricky input/expected pairs covering every rule (Quranic annotation marks, dagger alif, digits, hamza forms, mixed)
pytest backend/corpus/tests/test_arabic.py passes all fixture pairs for both entry points

userStories.title: Data models: quran + corpus apps with pgvector
acceptanceCriteria: Apps quran, corpus, search, clips, accounts created and in INSTALLED_APPS

quran.models: Surah(number PK, name_ar, name_ar_plain, name_en, ayah_count, revelation_place, order_revealed), Ayah(surah FK, number, text_uthmani, text_imlaei, text_normalized, juz, hizb, page, sajda, unique(surah,number))

corpus.models: Source, AudioAsset(sha256 unique), Segment(kind choices recitation|khawatir, status choices pending|transcribed|aligned|indexed|failed, index on (surah,ayah_start)), Transcript(segment OneToOne, version int), TranscriptWord(unique(transcript,idx), index(transcript,start_ms)), Chunk(embedding VectorField(1024) null), PipelineRun log model
All timestamps integer milliseconds (PositiveBigIntegerField/IntegerField), no floats
Migrations apply cleanly against pgvector Postgres 16 (CREATE EXTENSION vector via migration), verified by `manage.py migrate` against the docker db
HNSW index on Chunk.embedding (vector_cosine_ops) exists in a migration

userStories.title: import_quran management command
acceptanceCriteria: python manage.py import_quran downloads/uses Tanzil uthmani + imlaei sources (cached under backend/quran/data/), populates Surah+Ayah with juz/page metadata, fills text_normalized via normalize_for_index
After run: exactly 114 Surah rows and 6236 Ayah rows
Second run is idempotent: reports 0 created, DB row contents unchanged
Ayah 2:255 text_uthmani starts with the Ayat al-Kursi text and is non-empty in both uthmani and imlaei forms
pytest test covers parser + idempotency using a small fixture slice

userStories.title: Ingestion pipeline: audio to timestamped words
acceptanceCriteria: pipeline/ package with own requirements.txt (heavy deps) and requirements-stub.txt (test deps only); Django never imports pipeline (verified by grep: no 'import pipeline' under backend/)
pipeline/parsers.py: config-driven regex list loaded from pipeline/parser_patterns.json, parse_filename() returns surah/ayah range/kind/ordinal; CLI --dry-run prints parse results without writing
Celery stages ingest, transcode, transcribe, align, chunk, embed, index_segment on dedicated 'pipeline' queue; each checks Segment.status + sha256 and skips completed work (idempotent)
ASR/aligner/embedder behind pluggable engine interface; stub engines produce deterministic words with ms timings; faster-whisper + e5 real engine modules exist with lazy imports
Chunking: split where inter-word gap > 400ms AND chunk >= 20s, hard max 45s; recitation segments never split mid-ayah (test proves both rules)
Failure: corrupted audio marks that Segment failed with traceback recorded in PipelineRun, batch continues (test proves it)

run_pipeline management command with --limit and --surah flags; end-to-end test with ffmpeg-synthesized audio + stub engines yields Transcript, TranscriptWord (integer ms), Chunk rows; re-run reports all skipped

userStories.title: Search: lexical + semantic + hybrid
acceptanceCriteria: search/services.py: Meilisearch index 'chunks' configured with searchable=[text_normalized], filterable=[surah,kind,ayah_start], sortable=[surah,start_ms]; documents carry {id,segment_id,surah,ayah_start,ayah_end,kind,text,text_normalized,start_ms,end_ms}
Queries pass through normalize_for_index before hitting Meili (test: query with wrong hamzas/diacritics returns same results as canonical spelling, against live Meilisearch)
Semantic path: pgvector cosine distance over Chunk.embedding with query embedded via pluggable embedder (e5 'query: '/'passage: ' prefixes in real engine)
Hybrid: reciprocal rank fusion k=60 merging lexical+semantic lists; mode parameter lexical|semantic|hybrid, default hybrid; unit tests for RRF math
Ayah reference parser resolves '2:255', 'البقرة 255', and known ayah names ('آية الكرسي') to exact Ayah hits surfaced separately
EXPLAIN output for the semantic query shows the HNSW index scan (test asserts 'hnsw' or index name in plan)

userStories.title: API layer
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoints: GET /api/surahs/, /api/surahs/{n}/ (ayahs paginated by 20), /api/ayahs/{surah}/{ayah}/ (with covering segments), /api/segments/{id}/ (signed audio+waveform URLs), /api/segments/{id}/transcript/ (compact keys i,t,s,e,c), /api/search/, /api/topics/, /api/topics/{slug}/, POST /api/corrections/, GET+POST /api/clips/
Transcript and ayah responses send Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable (content-addressed by transcript version); search sends no-store

Audio URLs are server-side presigned S3 URLs (R2 endpoint https://6452da3166483560913682a6dd5a5b77.r2.cloudflarestorage.com bucket shaarawy in prod, MinIO in dev), 6h TTL; raw storage keys never appear in responses (test asserts)
Throttles: search 30/min anon, corrections 10/hour, clips 5/hour (DRF throttle classes, test proves 429)
drf-spectacular schema generates; make types produces frontend/src/types/api.ts via openapi-typescript; tsc compiles it with zero any
pytest suite covers every endpoint with a fixture surah + segment + transcript, all passing

userStories.title: Frontend foundation: RTL, fonts, audio store
acceptanceCriteria: Root layout has dir="rtl" lang="ar" on <html>; no per-component RTL hacks
Two self-hosted fonts via next/font/local: a Uthmani face for ayah text and an Arabic UI face for everything else, with font-display strategy that avoids layout shift (size-adjust/fallback metrics)
frontend/DESIGN.md records the design direction: two-typeface identity, restraint, no cream-paper-terracotta, highlight as signature element, reduced-motion + 360px + focus-visible floor

Zustand store owns a single global <audio> element mounted in root layout that survives route changes; store API: load(segment), play, pause, seekMs, setRate, position persistence to localStorage per segment
NextAuth remnants removed or isolated so the app builds without auth config; tsc strict passes with no any; npm run build succeeds

userStories.title: Player screen /listen/[segmentId]
acceptanceCriteria: Word highlight driven by requestAnimationFrame loop with binary search over word start times (audio.currentTime*1000), early bail when index unchanged; unit test for the binary search
Transcript virtualized with @tanstack/react-virtual; auto-scroll keeps active line ~40% viewport, disabled on user scroll with a 'back to current' affordance
Click any word seeks audio to word.start_ms/1000
Deep link ?t=<ms> starts playback at that position; share button writes current position into URL
Keyboard: space play/pause, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight seek 10s, '/' focuses search; Media Session API metadata + seek handlers wired
Playback speed 0.75/1/1.25/1.5, sleep timer, remembered position per segment via localStorage
Machine-transcript disclosure marker permanently visible on transcript views; prefers-reduced-motion makes highlight instant and disables smooth scroll
vitest unit tests for binary search + store logic pass; production build succeeds

userStories.title: Pages: landing, surah, search, topics
acceptanceCriteria: / is a search-first landing where the input is the hero
/surah/[n] lists ayahs (Uthmani face) with segment entry points
/search?q= shows results with matched snippet and inline play that starts audio at the result timestamp without navigation
/topics and /topics/[slug] render published topics and their chunks
Navigating between routes never interrupts playback (audio element in root layout)
npm run build passes; eslint passes

userStories.title: Corrections & review (Phase 6)
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/corrections/ accepts {chunk_id, word_start, word_end, suggested_text}, no account required, IP rate-limited
Django admin queue shows original vs suggested side-by-side with an audio play link for the exact word range
Admin approve action rewrites the affected TranscriptWord rows, bumps Transcript.version, and re-runs chunk text rebuild + reindex for affected chunks only (test proves version bump + text change)
Frontend: selecting words in the transcript offers 'suggest a correction' posting to the API
is_human_reviewed surfaces in transcript API and as a subtle verified state in UI

userStories.title: Topics & discovery (Phase 7)
acceptanceCriteria: Topic(slug, name_ar, description_ar, is_published default False) + ChunkTopic(chunk, topic, score) models
build_topics management command clusters chunk embeddings (HDBSCAN if available, KMeans fallback) and creates unpublished topics with pluggable labeler (LLM labeler stubbed, interface real)
Topics API only exposes is_published=True (test proves unpublished hidden)
Related-passages endpoint: nearest neighbours by embedding excluding same segment, used by player UI

userStories.title: Clip cards (Phase 8)
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/clips/ validates 15-60s range (hard cap 60s), enqueues Celery render; GET /api/clips/{id}/ reports status + URL

Render task builds ASS subtitle file with per-word \k karaoke timing from TranscriptWord and burns onto 1080x1920 canvas, audio trimmed via -ss/-to, output H.264+AAC (verified by ffprobe in test with synthesized audio)
Renders cached by (segment_id, start_ms, end_ms, preset): second request returns existing clip without re-render (test)
3 visual presets defined server-side; every clip carries site-URL attribution text
/clip/[id] share page with OG video tags + direct download link

userStories.title: Offline & PWA (Phase 9)
acceptanceCriteria: Serwist service worker: precache shell, stale-while-revalidate for transcripts, cache-first for ayah text
Save-for-offline per segment: downloads audio + transcript into Cache Storage with storage usage indicator and per-item delete
Arabic manifest with maskable icons; installable
npm run build succeeds with the SW registered in production build only

userStories.title: Production hardening (Phase 10)

/healthz (liveness) and /readyz (DB+redis+meili checks) endpoints exist and are tested

sitemap.xml covers surahs and ayahs; per-ayah/per-segment SEO metadata in frontend

A synthesized audio fixture runs the whole pipeline (stub engines) end-to-end producing indexed chunks; /api/search/?q= returns the chunk with correct start_ms

Frontend production build passes
